name: Shanghai Sanyou Medical Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Sanyou Medical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells orthopedics implants in China. It is also involved in production of ultrasonic power equipment and consumables. The company offers spinal and trauma implants under Tytus and Sanyou brand. Its spinal products comprise anterior cervical plate, anterior thoracolumbar, posterior cervical, posterior thoracolumbar, and minimally invasive products; and shoulder and elbow system, hip and pelvis system, knee joint system, foot and ankle, and palm and wrist systems. In addition, the company offers spinal implant, trauma implant consumables, ultrasonic power system products, and vertebral body shaping consumables. Further, …
